caption: Figure 1: Illustration of our framework which jointly learns contextualized speech representations and an inventory of discretized speech units.
description:
Figure type: Diagram
Description: The figure illustrates a framework for self-supervised learning of speech representations. It shows a rectangular block labeled "x" representing input speech data, a funnel-shaped block labeled "z" representing discretized speech units, and a waveform below labeled "x" representing the audio signal. The framework jointly learns contextualized speech representations and an inventory of discretized speech units.

Text in figure: x, z, x

caption: Figure 2: Mask length distribution for a 15 second sample with p = 0 . 065 and M = 10 .
description:
Section 1: Figure description
This figure is a line graph showing the distribution of mask lengths for a 15-second speech sample. The x-axis represents the span length, ranging from 0 to 100, while the y-axis represents the percentage of all spans. The graph displays a sharp peak at the beginning, followed by a rapid decline and a plateau.

Section 2: Figure details
Text in figure: "Percent of all spans", "Span length"
Key points:
- Highest point: Approximately 0.25% at span length 0
- Lowest point: Approximately 0% at span length 100
- Mask length distribution: Sharp peak at the beginning, rapid decline, and plateau

description:
## Description
This figure is a visualization of the co-occurrence between discrete latent speech representations and phonemes. It plots the conditional probability P(phoneme | q_t) on TIMIT train data. The y-axis represents the 39 collapsed classes of phonemes, while the x-axis shows the different discrete latents. The figure shows how certain phonemes are more likely to occur with specific latents.

## Text in figure

- x-axis: different discrete latents
- Plot: conditional probability P(phoneme | q_t)
